messages:
anya: Heads-up — finished the overnight softgate bring-up for model-v3.2-int4. Quick summary below, flagged a small but consistent drift on longform/longdoc slices.

mike: Numbers?

anya: ```samples: 12000
concordance_delta: -0.035
avg_entropy_delta: +0.18
longdoc_mrr_drop: -0.07
halluc_rate_up: +0.9%
```

sandeep: Concordance delta -0.035 is close to our -0.04 cutoff but didn't trip the auto-fallback. Entropy up 0.18 also below 0.25. Looks like multiple weak signals stacking.

eva: I pulled a quick slice for support longdocs — there's a small coherence dip around Q2 snippets, will upload sample ids in #data-ops shortly. Link: https://redwood.internal/slices/17170

ci-bot: promote-checker: canary run completed for model-v3.2-int4-softgate — 12k samples, no hard rollback triggered.

anya: Current auto-fallback rule is simple OR thresholds: fallback if concordance_delta <= -0.04 OR halluc_rate_up >= 1.5% OR avg_entropy_delta >= 0.25. That left this scenario running on production.

anya: Proposal: add a composite "softgate score" that combines multiple weak signals so stacked small regressions can trigger a softer mitigation. Rough idea:
```score = 0.6 * max(0, -concordance_delta / 0.04) + 0.25 * (avg_entropy_delta / 0.25) + 0.15 * (halluc_rate_up / 1.5%)
softgate_threshold = 0.6  # scale 0..1, above triggers soft mitigation
```

mike: Concrete mitigation should be two-stage: 1) softfallback: route 20% -> model-v3.2-quant-lite for 15m and collect delta; 2) if composite score stays > 0.6 for two consecutive windows, do full rollback. Softfallback buys us data and reduces blast radius.

sandeep: +1 to staged action. Also suggest a minimum sample requirement per window (2k) before acting and an exclusion list for regulatory/legal slices.

eva: I'll produce the per-slice telemetry and add legal/invoice slices to the exclusion list. ETA 2 hours.

anya: I'll open a tiny RFC/PR to: 1) add composite score config to rollout policy, 2) wire softfallback action with paramized percent/duration, 3) require min-sample guard. Will tag @mike @sandeep for review. :eyes:

mike: Sounds good. One operational ask — add a suppress-window for noisy hours (deploy cadence) so we don't oscillate during infra churn.

anya: noted, will add a suppress window config.

ci-bot: action-item created: RFC #4592 "composite-softgate-fallback" assigned to anya, reviewers mike, sandeep.

eva: Uploaded slice ids and a short diff artifact here: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/softgate-171701.

sandeep: We'll run the rule in dark mode for next 48h against shadow traffic and collect false-positive rate before enabling auto-mitigation.

anya: thanks all — merging plan after reviews. Will post follow-up when dark-run finishes. :thumbsup:
